reviews.text: Love this app. The app is so beautifully designed without being super overwhelming- the icons, placement and color scheme are pleasant and not jarring and you can easily navigate to where ever you need to go without much guidance. (Quite intuitive). Have been using it for sometime and loved it. Thanks for the thoughtfulness and everything behind the scenes that has made this app possible.
App is not syncing accurate with my dashboard. App is not syncing accurately with my dashboard, see last week Thursday, before and after.
Wonderful sessions. Wonderful daily sessions with exercises for every part of the body 🙌🙌🙌

Great creativity. Really Enjoyed Box Breathing. Thanks 
Have some Meditation
Great, Simple and Effective. I started with free 21 day program in June and became a member. It has been great experience for fast one month and I am forced to do it everyday as I enjoy .

I am healthy and happybecause of Habuild. I had never thought that I would be able to do yoga at age of 73. But Habuild made it true and I am regularly enjoying with proud feeling. Thanks to you Saurabh and my friend Rashmi from whom I got this. I promise to do life time. It's not only physical but mentally feeling very cool and calm. After yoga I do breathing session everyday that keeps my asthmatic problem in control. I enjoy meditation and laughter too. Thank you for everything . God bless you all🙏🌹🙏
Excellent Daily Yoga exercise sessions. Keep on going for ever.. 👌👌👌

Worst fitness application. The application is getting worse. First they make the app like watsapp. If people have watsapp with your chats, then why make an app again with same interface. Now the yoga days got reset. Why developer why. Why can’t the application team first test the application then deploy the code.

Phenomenal Job by the Habuild team. The Habuild team has done a phenomenal job supporting a broad community in achieving and maintaining their health goals. To enhance this journey, they have introduced a wonderful initiative by gamifying the experience through their mobile application. While I am uncertain if this feature was only recently deployed, receiving a push notification to solve a math puzzle was a surprise and a welcome break from daily routines. It is an excellent strategy for keeping the mind active alongside physical well-being.
Habuild-a MUST habit !!. Excellent!

Simply life changing. It’s more powerful than words can express. I look forward to the yoga session everyday. It makes me physically and mentally stronger. It makes me feel good both physically and mentally. I feel like my back, ankle, knees, shoulders. Hop area is all stronger now. It’s a magic that you see one day at a time.
Great app to match the invaluable sessions. Thanks to the Habuild team for creating this complimentary app for members. It’s useful and at the same time pleasing as well. Keep up the great work!

The best habit - Habuild !!. Yoga is like a self SPA for me. So relaxing and brings in so much of flexibility over the years - you need to do it to feel it. Sourabh Sir & Trishala Mam are my guru. I keep switching between the classes to maintain both flexibility and strength of my muscles. They have so many informative videos to learn from about good habits and maintain a healthy life style. The app is super user friendly. Daily classes are active for 24 hours. They have taken every effort to make YOGA and exercise a daily regime in one’s life - you stay in a different country and unable to match the time? Use the app. It’s valid for 24 hours. You want to repeat the movements longer than suggested use the app, pause the recorded video, meet your target count, resume the video for the next movement. It’s that user-friendly !!!!

Perfect platform to do yoga. Best online yoga platform! The company name is so appropriate I really experience that, If I can’t make it during my regular schedule time I tried to do another time of the day it’s that much I got habituated and if I don’t do I feel
Like I’m missing yoga today.
This is great for all age groups and if any health issues people can do easy variations. The teach so clearly and it’s helpful. 
The community events are very informative for a healthy life style..
Technology is at its best use and now great to see the app has been introduced 
Congratulations and Thanks to Saurabh Sir and the Team!

The best thing I have ever done. Habuild is not only making me stronger and more flexible but it did teach me to be consistent, punctual and be a better person in all aspects. Ever grateful for my guru Bothra. 🙏🏻
Habuilder. Habuild yoga and breathing has changed the approach for life. It’s a wonderful experience to be part of this movement to make life better. Keep it Saurabh sir, Chotu ji and team habuild.

Excellent Yoga Training for All Ages. I really enjoy HA Build. I do yoga there every day, and I truly love the way he teaches. His teaching style is very good and easy to follow. He teaches yoga for young people, adults, and older people as well, according to their age and capacity. He understands each person’s ability and guides them in a very supportive and caring way. I feel happy and comfortable attending every day. Highly recommended for anyone who wants to practice yoga in a safe and effective way.
The Best structured Program Ever. Have done so many yoga classes, this is the best ever. Well designed, balanced, complete workout. God bless Saurabh for giving us this gift of life.

Dr. Utpal Banik’s Review. Saurabh ji’s Habuild organization is an amazing organization. The thing I like most is that not a single day is a boring day for me. The daily variation is my motivation and the way he teaches yoga practices. His combination of Ashana, meditation and breathing practices are the source of my everyday energy🤩. Thank you and your team what you offer us worldwide.

Hooked for life with Yoga Everyday 😃. Saurabh ji 

All my life I wanted to do Yog everyday at the privacy of my home at my time. 

You my Yog guru have solved all of these while being the best EVERYDAY. 

Thank you for 
* giving me LIFE, 
* bringing my SMILE back and 
* deepening my MEDITATION. 
Can anything be said to convey this gratitude!

🙏🏼🌷 May millions be inspired by you to do something as meaningful to revive Dharma!

Peace of Mind. I’m so grateful for these online yoga sessions. They have truly helped me relax and clear my mind. After each class, I feel calmer, more focused, and less stressed. The guidance is easy to follow, and practicing from home has made it simple to stay consistent. This has had a positive impact on both my mental well-being and daily life. I highly recommend these sessions to anyone looking to bring more peace and balance into their routine.
Thank you. This is great doing Box breathing. I look forward to you expanding to other techniques such as Nasal Breathing, ujayji, brahmari and fast breathing.

Inner peace. I feel very healthy , very confident and relaxed from the time I have joined Habuild yoga . Had both knees replaced n it does not hold me from not coming on the mat daily. Look n feel younger than my age of young 75 female as the child in me is still there. Thanks Saurabh sir n Chottu. Bless you both . 💕🙏🙌🌹
Amazing yoga class. I am really appreciate Saurabhji and Chhotu being such a great instructor for me and I really enjoyed their session I don’t want to miss any single day thank you so much 🙏

Discipline due to Yoga. This is the best Yoga class ever. It makes you disciplined to do Yoga every day. Saurabh Sir is very considerate in teaching. He doesn’t enforce anything on you. It is all up to us how much we want to flex our body as per our body type and age. Love this kind of training for someone like me at 57.

Gratitude. Habuild community is one of the best online platforms and I am so grateful that I came across this platform through a friend of mine. Due to Habuild I have been able to get back my mobility and flexibility which seemed impossible for me after Covid. Thank you Saurabh Sir and Chotu and the entire Habuild team. Words cannot express my gratitude to its fullest. Thank you🙏🏻and I enjoy practicing everyday despite I miss a day or two here & there. May you be blessed to continue this Habuild community and may you keep making a difference for 1000’s of people🙏🏻
